blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Numbers are everywhere at work. We use them for extensions, for meeting rooms, for page numbers, and for floors. Today Sophie helps a new hire. She wants to teach the numbers from one to twenty.

"Your extension is seventeen," Sophie says. "The meeting is in room twelve. HR is on the second floor." The new hire writes everything down. He is a little nervous, but Sophie is calm and kind.

"English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts," Sophie says with a smile. "We go step by step. You can do it!" The new hire feels better. Numbers one to twenty are not hard. He is ready to start.

items.q: What does Sophie want to teach the new hire?
options: The numbers from one to twenty
How to use the coffee machine
items.why: "She wants to teach the numbers from one to twenty."

items.q: Where is HR?
items.why: "HR is on the second floor."

items.q: What is the new hire's extension?
items.why: "Your extension is seventeen," Sophie says.

items.q: The new hire is a little nervous. What does this suggest?
options: He is new and everything is fresh for him
He already knows all the numbers
items.why: Inferência: ele é novo (new hire) e está aprendendo — por isso o nervosismo.

items.q: Sophie says "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts." She most likely wants the new hire to feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase é de encorajamento — "você consegue", então ela quer que ele se sinta confiante.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie no primeiro dia do novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the team. Let me give you some numbers. They are easy, don't worry.

First, your phone. Your extension is fifteen. One, five. If you need me, my extension is seven. Just dial seven.

Our team meeting is today. It is in room twenty. Room two, zero, at the end of the hall. The big room, not the small one.

The office manager sits on floor three. Take the lift and press three. HR is on floor two. So, HR is on two, and the manager is on three. Easy, right?

Oh, and one more thing. The phone on your desk is desk number four. When it rings, you can pick it up. If the person is not for you, you say "one moment, please," and you call me on extension seven.

That is all for now. Numbers one to twenty. You will use them every day. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the new hire's extension?
items.why: "Your extension is fifteen. One, five."

items.q: Where is the team meeting?
items.why: "Our team meeting is today. It is in room twenty."

items.q: HR is on which floor?
items.why: "HR is on floor two."

items.q: Sophie says to call her extension when the call is not for you. What does this suggest about her?
options: She wants to help the new hire
She is too busy to talk
items.why: Inferência: ela se oferece para ajudar com as ligações, então quer apoiar o novo colega.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "don't worry", "easy, right?" e "you can do it!" — um tom amigável e tranquilo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My extension is seventeen." An extension is…
options: your short phone number at work
items.why: Extension = ramal: o número curto do seu telefone no trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The meeting is in ___ twelve."
items.why: Room = sala. A reunião acontece na sala doze.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "HR is on the second ___."
items.why: Floor = andar. RH fica no segundo andar.

items.q: "The phone is on desk four." A phone is…
options: the thing you use to call people
items.why: Phone = telefone: o aparelho que você usa para ligar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "My ___ is seven, so just dial seven."
items.why: Number = número. "Meu número é sete."

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos no telefone e no escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "When the phone rings, you can pick it up." To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = atender o telefone.

items.q: "Sorry, wrong number. I will hang up now." To hang up means to…
items.why: Hang up = desligar o telefone, encerrar a ligação.

items.q: "She is busy now. Can you call back later?" To call back means to…
items.why: Call back = ligar de novo mais tarde.

items.q: "One moment, please. I will put you through to HR." To put through means to…
items.why: Put through = transferir/passar a ligação para outra pessoa.

items.q: "Please hold on, I will find the room number." To hold on means to…
items.why: Hold on = espere um momento, aguarde na linha.
